definitions.explanation: A slight, often unsettling smile that suggests mockery, insincerity, or hidden intent. Almost always carries a negative connotation, unlike a genuine smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべた→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
examples.english: He let a smirk cross his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気味|きみ}{悪|わる}くて→気味悪い：10642_kimiwarui⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{謝罪会見|しゃざいかいけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びた→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
examples.english: Showing a smirk during the apology press conference drew criticism.

notes:
USAGE:
{薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い almost always has a negative connotation. It suggests the person is being insincere, mocking, or hiding something. It is not used for a genuine, warm smile.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ (to show a smirk)
- {薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to display a smirk)
- ⟦{不気味|ぶきみ}→不気味：16040_bukimi⟧な{薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い (an eerie smirk)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{苦笑|くしょう}→苦笑：08688_kushou⟧い is a wry or bitter smile at something awkward. {薄|うす}ら{笑|わら}い is more sinister or unsettling.
